text.description_html:
Commercial Interchangeable Core (IC) Lever For Panic Device

Philadelphia style commercial levers are rated a Grade 2. Available in Night Light and Classroom functions.

These commercial levers are ADA compliant.

Specifications: for PDQ SD Series IC Lever Locksets

  • Handing: Non-handed.
  • Trim: Philadelphia Levers zinc diecast.
  • Interchangeable Core: Small format IC less core (no lock cylinder).
  • Finish: Satin Chrome

Available Functions: for PDQ SD Series IC Lever Locksets

  • Night Latch: Night Latch Function Lever: Outside entrance by lever when latch bolt is retracted by Key.
  • Classroom: Outside lever locked and unlocked by key.
